title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/systems.json
description: Nano's systems on the card (esdeSystemsJson, NanoMenuXmb.cpp). The launch fields (launchType, coreSo, package, launchArgs, intentTemplate) are each system's emulator pick, in Nano's own terms on both platforms (coreSo is the Android core file name, <core>_libretro_android.so, everywhere): the last pick wins, on either platform (OA-38). A platform that cannot run a system's pick starts it with its own default and leaves the fields as they are; a writer changes a system's launch fields only when the user picks its emulator. Both platforms may write the other fields. The scraper accounts are never on the card: the scraper object allows only override and platform (OA-32 Q6). Unknown fields are allowed because the file is already in the field; Android rebuilds it from structs, so a field only Linux knows does not survive an Android save. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

intentTemplate.description: Launch field (Android-owned): am start arguments with {file.uri} and the other tokens.

scraper.description: Only the per-system scraper choice; user, pass and key are device-only and never written here.

value.description: The card's own volume is written as %CARDID%.
